senses.gloss:
Apvā.--A disease affecting the stomach, possibly dysentery, as suggested by Zimmer, on the ground that the disease is invoked to confound the enemy. Weber considers that it is diarrhœa induced by fear, as often in the Epic. This view is supported by Bloomfield, and was apparently that of yāska.
